scope: Pre-tuning diagnostic evaluation; no smartphone-data training in this run
steps: Evaluate all verified original crops using NFC-only CER/EM and numeric-symbol EM
Evaluate aligned coordinate images with fixed detector and IoU>=0.5 maximum-cardinality one-to-one matching; score missed GT as empty predictions
Persist detection crops, all predictions, and overlays; unannotated detections remain unscored
Qualitatively inspect a deterministic 20-image subset of unaligned source PNGs; do not assign aligned GT to raw coordinates
Compare recognition errors against detection/matching failures and prepare prioritized tuning recommendations
holdout_policy: This is all-data diagnostic evaluation, not an untouched test set. Future final generalization testing requires pre-isolated or newly collected receipt/rephotograph groups.
retry_note: raw_preview_v1 stopped on a polygon list/array conversion error; preserved and retried in raw_preview_v2 after accepting either representation
